codebook_semantics_resolution.rule: ALLOW, DENY and ABSTAIN may appear only inside the episode-local codebook definition. They are forbidden in situation/query text and the answer contains only the selected opaque symbol.
codebook_semantics_resolution.reason: This resolves the source-spec tension explicitly instead of silently mixing incompatible leakage rules.
codebook_semantics_resolution.alternative_not_selected: A separately versioned label-free demonstration codebook remains a future ablation, not mixed into v4.

episode_contract.symbol_pool: 46 accepted ABI atoms only; rejected atom 'or' excluded by manifest-bound renderer
episode_contract.answer: exactly one ABI symbol token; no rationale
episode_contract.target_symbol_leakage: forbidden outside codebook span and answer
episode_contract.provenance: bind source package hash, ABI manifest hash, renderer/generator version, checkpoint/tokenizer identity and family ancestry

anti_shortcut_pair_families.construction: Keep semantic situation and three symbols fixed; change only the S3 mapping; target must change according to the new codebook.
anti_shortcut_pair_families.purpose: Forces codebook binding instead of semantic-class-to-fixed-token memorization.

anti_shortcut_pair_families.construction: Keep codebook and surface frame fixed; minimally change admitted facts so latent class changes; target must follow the new class-to-symbol binding.
anti_shortcut_pair_families.purpose: Forces semantic readout instead of codebook-position memorization.

anti_shortcut_pair_families.construction: Keep mapping constant but reorder codebook entries; target must remain invariant.
Change non-semantic punctuation/harmless wording/ordering while keeping semantic decision and codebook fixed; target must remain invariant.
anti_shortcut_pair_families.purpose: Direct response to Claude T01 where nuisance control produced a larger behavioral effect than the semantic condition.

anti_shortcut_pair_families.construction: Replace all three codebook symbols with a fresh unseen triple while preserving semantic class and S3 permutation; target must follow the new symbol assignment.
anti_shortcut_pair_families.purpose: Tests variable binding to symbols rather than memorized token priors.

template_curriculum.holdout_visibility: T5 is absent from train and validation and cannot be used for prompt/hyperparameter/evaluator selection.
template_curriculum.note: The four measured template families showed strong within-template decoding but poor cross-template transfer; v4 therefore trains explicit multi-template binding and reserves a fifth unseen structural family.

symbol_holdout.selection: derive deterministically from the exact ABI manifest hash plus atom-row identity before generation; freeze before training
symbol_holdout.reason: Avoid human cherry-picking and require generalization to genuinely unseen output atoms.

split_contract.train: T1-T4, train lexical families, 38-symbol pool, all six S3 permutations
split_contract.validation: T1-T4 with disjoint calibration lexical families, same 38-symbol pool, all six S3 permutations
split_contract.holdout_template: T5 only, disjoint lexical family, all six S3 permutations
split_contract.holdout_symbol: unseen 8-symbol pool; no holdout symbol appears in train/validation
split_contract.holdout_composed: T5 plus unseen-symbol triples plus disjoint lexical family
split_contract.independence_verification: must be independently recomputed from rendered rows; row-declared booleans are insufficient

scale_plan.phase_0: 36 audited golden generator cases only; no training credit
scale_plan.phase_1: small deterministic rendered seed after ABI/manifest checks and linter PASS
scale_plan.phase_2: 20k-50k candidate rows only after swarm review of phase_1
scale_plan.balancing: exact or at-most-one differences per class x symbol x template x permutation cells; report mutual information and reject material class-symbol dependence
scale_plan.do_not_scale_on: raw row/token volume without evidence-qualified admission

composition: 18 core rows = 6 S3 permutations x 3 latent classes on one semantic counterfactual family
12 transfer rows = 4 train templates x 3 latent classes with disjoint surface realizations

swarm_review.independence_note: These are role-separated reviews by one ChatGPT organ, not independent model replications; agreement mints no empirical credit.
findings: Do not train the already-present semantic read/write primitives as if absent; concentrate gradient budget on the missing conditional binding computation.
Do not use static steering-vector success as a training label; Claude T01 shows internal transport can dissociate from behavior.
Full S3 mappings must alter the realized class-to-symbol mapping, not metadata only.
Counterbalancing must be independently measured, not asserted by a generator flag.
T5 and unseen symbols must remain frozen and invisible during selection.
Every rendered symbol must be checked against the exact accepted ABI manifest and tokenizer identity.
Retention evaluation must guard general reasoning/protocol behavior and any required multimodal path from catastrophic forgetting.
The harness should consume the same episode/codebook schema so training and later go-harness behavior share one ABI rather than two semantic conventions.

behavioral_primary: dynamic codebook accuracy >=0.90 on frozen holdout
context-invariant cross-template binding >=0.90 on frozen holdout
counterfactual remap consistency: same semantics + changed codebook must change answer exactly as mapping dictates
retention: multimodal retention if final checkpoint is required to preserve vision
evaluation_gates.jspace: No positive Qwen3.5 J-Space promotion from this curriculum. Same-model causal receipts remain separately required.
promotion_integrity: prompt bytes + token tensor bytes/dtype/shape cross-bound in one trial identity
control receipts recomputed from actual bytes, not only shape-checked
family completeness checked per calibration family
independence derived from provenance/split data, never self-declared
live gate path must be explicitly versioned and end-to-end wired before it can promote any result

next_exact_actions: Commit and lint the 36-row golden episode specification.
Implement a manifest-bound renderer that resolves abstract symbol slots to accepted ABI atoms and rejects 'or'.
Implement an independent leakage/counterbalance/family-split linter that derives statistics from rendered data rather than trusting row claims.
Run swarm review over the rendered small seed before expanding toward 20k-50k rows.
Keep Base-vs-posttrained checkpoint selection unresolved until matched free/local pilots on the frozen curriculum are possible.
